Amazon Bedrock gives you access to hundreds of leading foundation models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Amazon, and more. You can also deploy and serve custom models using Amazon SageMaker AI. Choose the right model for each task without being locked into a single provider. How does AWS help control AI costs? Cost control and visibility across AI workloads (training, inference, agent operations) in one billing view. Purpose-built chips like Trainium deliver 30-40% better price-performance. Additional levers: model distillation (smaller models that cost less), intelligent prompt routing (routes queries to balance cost and quality), and auto-scaling that matches capacity to demand. How does AWS secure AI workloads? AWS pioneered automated reasoning to bring mathematical verification to AI. Automated Reasoning checks in Amazon Bedrock Guardrails help detect factual errors and validate responses against polices you define.
